# Integration identity assets

Selected SVG files from [SVG Logos](https://github.com/gilbarbara/logos), revision `d6960edc1b7309d392c76e40d3a320df7f9ff85c`.
The collection is CC0-1.0; its license is retained beside this file. Brand marks identify
the corresponding providers and do not imply endorsement. Assets are served locally.

- `public/integrations/chatgpt.svg`: `logos/openai-icon.svg`
- `public/integrations/claude.svg`: `logos/claude-icon.svg`
- `public/integrations/gmail.svg`: `logos/google-gmail-2020.svg`
- `public/integrations/slack.svg`: `logos/slack-icon.svg`
- `public/integrations/google-calendar.svg`: `logos/google-calendar-2020.svg`
- `public/integrations/microsoft365.svg`: `logos/microsoft-icon.svg`
- `public/integrations/zoom.svg`: `logos/zoom-icon.svg`
